main_text.p: nis jus esset judices Ostergoos cessantes in officio, ad faciendum officium compellere. Subscripsere fœderi, primùm senatus populusque Doccumanus, antistites cœ-nobiorum sex, & magnus nobilium virorum numerus, præter vicos & vicanos plurimos, dein plures se paulatim asso-ciarunt, demùm universa Ostergoa, exceptis quos factionum studium in diver-sa agebat, est asscripta : unde fœdus Ostergoum vulgo nuncupatum fuit. Anno postero M. cccc. XCII. cùm tumultus hujus fœderis gratia extitissent, autore potissimùm & concitatore Tiardo Moc-cama, totaque Sciringiorum factio in Westergoa se commoveret, Leoardii à vi factionis sibi metuentes, ut se magis magisque firmarent, speciali se fœdere & arctiore cum Groninganis junxerunt. Hoc fœdere promisère Senior, Scabini, Se-Fœdus Leoar-diumnatus reliquus & XIII. viri totius populi nomine, fideles se socios Groningensium futuros in annos XXIIII ex formulâ fœderis Doccumani, ejusque fœderis conditiones om-nes servaturòs : præterea permissuros, ut fines[?] civium suorum cum civibus, de qui-

page.notes: The first word of the italic line "fines[?]" is partly cut off at the left edge of the scan; the reading is a likely guess. The page number "155" is set in a stylised form and is read as 155. The Roman numeral "XCII" in the date is read from a faint impression and is marked as a likely reading. The margin note "Fœdus Leoar-dium" is set in two lines, with the hyphen at the line end kept as printed. The catchword "bus" stands alone at the bottom right and is not repeated in the text.
